Rose Baker Foundation Professor of Management Practice Baker Foundation Professor of Management Practice Read more Clayton Rose is Baker Foundation Professor of Management Practice. His teaching is centered on the course Accountability in the Advanced Management Program and his case writing focuses on managing the intense and competing political and social pressures facing organizations today. He currently serves as the Faculty Chair for Career and Professional Development, and is also the chair of a faculty working group examining HBS MBA admissions.
